read_sas: read a SAS sas7bdat or xport file and return a DataFrame
read_sas_chunked: read a SAS file in chunks by specifying chunksize for incremental iteration
read_sas_iterator: read a SAS file incrementally using the iterator parameter to return a SASReader
read_sas_with_encoding: read a SAS file with a specified encoding for text data columns
read_sas_with_compression: read a compressed SAS file by inferring compression from the file extension
